import sys, json, random, ctypes
sys.path.insert(0,'.'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from brute import bf_compile_job
from gen import rand_job
rng = random.Random(12345)
bad = 0; n=0
for trial in range(500):
    job = rand_job(rng)
    if job is None:
        continue
    n+=1
    a = compile_job(job)
    b = bf_compile_job(job)
    if a != b:
        bad += 1
        print('MISMATCH trial', trial)
        print(json.dumps(job))
        print('GOT ', json.dumps(a))
        print('EXP ', json.dumps(b))
        if bad >= 2: break
print('tested', n, 'mismatches:', bad)
EOF
